title: Rowhousing with five or more dwelling units: which building services need registered-professional authentication (current R2)
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (Division C 2.4.1.1 and Division A 1.4.1.2 cited); joint with plumbing, gas and electrical STANDATA numbering; printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: May 2026 (platform created May 1, 2026, last updated May 28, 2026)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies professional involvement for building services and systems in a multiple-family dwelling with five or more dwelling units in a rowhouse configuration.
The NBC(AE) does not require professional involvement where a multiple-family dwelling contains four dwelling units or less.
The document notes that Sentence (3) has been interpreted by some to mean every aspect of such a dwelling must be designed by a registered professional in every discipline.
For buildings other than those described in Sentence (1), drawings and specifications must be authenticated by one or more registered professionals.
For the purposes of Sentence (1), secondary suites need not be considered as dwelling units.
